# 1. Emergency Imperial Debt Commission (oe_cat_economic_canals)
oe_dis2_dec_debt_commission = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_imperial_overextension
	}
	allow = {
		stability >= -20
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis2_dec_debt_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_dec_debt_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 10 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_dis2_dec_debt_commission.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dis2_dec_debt_commission_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_dec_debt_cd value = 1 years = 4 }
			oe_dis2_bump_overext_step = yes
			add_inflation = inflation_weak_bonus
			add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_mild_bonus
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis2_mod_debt_commission years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 3. Imperial Conciliation Edict (oe_cat_imperial_governance)
oe_dis2_dec_imperial_conciliation_edict = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		oe_dis2_has_conciliation_disaster = yes
	}
	allow = {
		gold >= 120
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_dis2_dec_concil_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_dec_concil_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 10 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_dis2_dec_imperial_conciliation_edict.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dis2_dec_imperial_conciliation_edict_tt
			add_gold = -120
			add_stability = 5
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_dec_concil_cd value = 1 years = 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_colonial_independence_wave }
				oe_dis2_bump_colonial_step = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_court_regency_crisis }
				oe_dis2_bump_regency_step = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_industrial_labor_unrest }
				oe_dis2_bump_labor_step = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_confessional_schism_backlash }
				oe_dis2_bump_schism_step = yes
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis2_mod_imperial_conciliation years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 4. Toggle Competitive AI Great-Power Resilience (oe_cat_imperial_governance)
oe_dis2_dec_toggle_ai_rivalry = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_dis2_dec_toggle_ai_rivalry.a
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_disabled }
				custom_tooltip = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_re_enable_tt
				remove_global_variable = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_disabled
			}
			else = {
				custom_tooltip = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_disable_tt
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_disabled value = 1 }
				oe_dis2_clear_all_ai_resilience = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
